name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
apply_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Fill the NMMS application under 'Fresh Registration'
Upload income certificate and caste certificate (if applicable)
Submit and note the application ID for tracking
School verifies the application before final approval

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
apply_steps: Register on NSP as a fresh applicant
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship - SC' scheme
Upload caste and income certificates
Fill institution and course details
Submit for institute verification

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
apply_steps: Register on NSP as a fresh applicant
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship - OBC' scheme
Upload OBC non-creamy layer certificate and income certificate
Fill institution and course details
Submit for institute verification

name: Pragati Scholarship for Girls (AICTE)
apply_steps: Register on the AICTE Pragati/Saksham portal
Fill personal and institution details
Upload admission letter and income certificate
Submit and track status via portal login

name: Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
apply_steps: Register on the AICTE Pragati/Saksham portal
Upload disability certificate issued by competent authority
Upload admission letter and income certificate
Submit and track status via portal login

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College Students
apply_steps: Register on NSP as fresh applicant
Select Central Sector Scheme
Upload Class 12 marksheet and income certificate
Submit for college verification
